# Prepare media for downstream steps
prepare_media(base_media="RPMI-1640", fbs_percentage="10%", volume="50 mL")

# Mash spleen through a filter to obtain single-cell suspension
mash_spleen_on_filter(spleen="mouse_spleen", filter_pore_size="70 µm", media_volume="10 mL", plunger="pestle")

# Wet the filter before use
wet_filter(filter_pore_size="70 µm", media_volume="5 mL", conical_volume="15 mL")

# Spin down the cell suspension
spin_cells(cell_suspension="spleen_cell_suspension", centrifuge_settings="300 x g, 5 min, 4°C")

# Remove supernatant after spin
remove_supernatant(cell_suspension="spleen_cell_pellet")

# Add ACK lysis buffer and repeat ACK steps (red blood cell lysis)
repeat_ACK_steps(cell_pellet="cell_pellet", buffer_type="ACK_lysis_buffer", volume="5 mL", incubation_time="2 min", temperature="room_temp")

# Spin again to pellet cells after ACK treatment
spin_cells(cell_suspension="cell_suspension_post_ACK", centrifuge_settings="300 x g, 5 min, 4°C")

# Remove supernatant after ACK spin
remove_supernatant(cell_suspension="cell_pellet_post_ACK")

# Resuspend the final cell pellet in complete media on ice
resuspend_pellet(cell_pellet="final_cell_pellet", buffer_type="RPMI-1640_10%FBS", volume="5 mL", incubation_time="5 min", temperature="on_ice")

# Keep cells on ice until staining
keep_cells_on_ice(media_type="RPMI-1640_10%FBS", cell_suspension="final_cell_suspension")

# Stain cells with desired antibodies and filter before sorting

vortex(solution="lysate")

# 3. Centrifuge at high speed to separate phases (increased speed)
centrifuge(solution="lysate", temperature="4°C", speed="14000 x g", duration="10 min")

# 4. Transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a new tube
pipette_aqueous_phase(source_tube="lysate", destination_tube="aqueous_phase", volume="500 µL")

# 5. Precipitate DNA with ethanol and sodium acetate
ethanol_precipitation(dna_solution="aqueous_phase", na_acetate_volume="50 µL")

# 6. Wash DNA pellet with 70% ethanol
wash_with_ethanol(solution="dna_pellet", ethanol_concentration="70%", solution_volume="1 mL")

# 7. Dry pellet on ice briefly
dry_on_ice(solution="dna_pellet", ice_type="cryo_ice", time="5 min")

resuspend_dna(dna_pellet="dna_pellet", final_volume="100 µL", buffer_type="TE", buffer_concentration="10 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA", buffer_ph="8.0")

# 9. Remove residual solvent with speed vacuum
speed_vac(solution="resuspended_dna", time="30 min", temperature="room_temp")

# 10. Dispose of the original lysate tube
dispose_of_original_tube(tube="lysate")

# 10. Wash DNA pellet with 70% ethanol

# Combine faecal material with lysis buffer
add_buffer(falcon_tube="sample_tube", volume="1.5 mL", buffer="Buffer AL")
# Add Proteinase K and incubate for extended lysis
incubate_samples(samples="sample_tube", temperature="56°C", time="60 min", inversion_times=5)
# Add additional Proteinase K and continue incubation
incubate_samples(samples="sample_tube", temperature="56°C", time="30 min", inversion_times=3)
# Centrifuge to pellet debris
centrifuge_supernatant(volume="1.5 mL", temperature="4°C", time="10 min", speed="14,000 x g")
# Transfer supernatant to new tube
# Add potassium acetate to precipitate inhibitors
add_KOAc(volume="200 µL", KOAc_solution="5 M KOAc")
# Mix by inversion
incubate_samples(samples="supernatant", temperature="room temp", time="5 min", inversion_times=10)
# Centrifuge to pellet precipitate
centrifuge_supernatant(volume="1.7 mL", temperature="4°C", time="10 min", speed="14,000 x g")
# Transfer cleared lysate to new tube
# Add isopropanol for DNA precipitation
isopropanol_precipitation(volume="1.8 mL", temperature="-20°C", time="30 min", speed="14,000 x g")
# Discard supernatant and dry pellet
dry_pellet(time="10 min")
# Resuspend DNA pellet in Buffer AE
resuspend_pellet(volume="200 µL", solution="Buffer AE")
# Perform ethanol wash
etoh_wash(volume="500 µL", temperature="70°C", time="5 min", speed="14,000 x g")
# Dry pellet again
dry_pellet(time="5 min")
# Final resuspension
resuspend_pellet(volume="100 µL", solution="TE buffer")
# RNase treatment to remove RNA
rnase_treatment(volume="100 µL", RNase="RNase A (10 mg/mL)", incubation_temp="37°C", time="15 min")
# Quantify DNA
nanodrop_qubit(dilution_factor=1, samples="final_DNA")
